last.verdict: Teva raised 2026 revenue and brand-drug targets again on fast growth in Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy, though total sales fell 2%.

takeaways.label: Brands carry the raise
takeaways.text: Austedo sales rose 21% to $751M, Ajovy 61% to $269M and Uzedy 96% to $85M. The 2026 Austedo outlook went up to $2.55–2.65B from $2.45–2.60B.

takeaways.label: Guidance lifted, profit target flat
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue outlook rose to $16.7–17.0B from $16.5–16.85B. Adjusted EPS stays $1.92–2.11, and the operating income range's top end was trimmed to $3.9B from $4.0B.

takeaways.label: Generics still shrinking
takeaways.text: Total revenue was $4.4B, down 2%, mainly from lower generic sales led by lenalidomide (a cancer drug). Gross margin improved to 55.5% from 51.4%.

takeaways.label: Heavy debt remains
takeaways.text: Debt was $16.7B at quarter-end, with about $4.9B refinanced in the quarter. Free cash flow was $495M and the full-year target edged up to $2.1–2.4B.

history.verdict: Stronger brand-drug sales and raised guidance outweighed a profit miss.

reasons.label: Austedo outlook raised
reasons.text: 2026 Austedo sales guidance lifted to $2.45–2.6 billion; U.S. sales up 33%.

reasons.label: Revenue guidance raised
reasons.text: 2026 revenue outlook raised to $16.5–16.85 billion on Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy.

reasons.label: Miss blamed on deal
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of 2 cents missed; Emalex acquisition cost about 61 cents per share.
